summary: I checked the Nobel Peace Prize field hours before today's announcement, Manchester United-Tottenham injury news, the Georgia-Alabama and South Carolina-Florida college football lines, Dortmund-Werder Bremen, and fresh Brazil runoff news. South Carolina-Florida stood out: five sportsbook sources put the real game total near 62, well above this market's 59.5 line, so I bought the Over there. Everything else was a hold: Nobel odds are split between Vanessa Nakate and my existing Sudan Emergency Response Rooms pick but prediction markets still favor it near my price, Tottenham's own injuries do not clearly flip the Manchester United thesis, and the Georgia-Alabama and Brazil runoff theses are unchanged by new reporting.
